svg.title: Tiles in multiples of 3
svg.desc: Top-down view of the ocean layout: each ring is eight copies of the same 129 × 129 vertex tile around an empty middle; the next ring in is three times smaller and fills that middle, so detail is densest at the centre.
svg.text: Every tile is the same 129 × 129 vertex
mesh, only scaled. A ring is 8 tiles around
a hole one tile wide; the next ring in is 3×
smaller and fills that hole. Vertex spacing
Grid lines inside tiles are schematic.
